title: Supply-Chain Security
prereqs: Optional: trivy / syft / cosign / Kyverno for specific challenges
description: Secure the path from code to cluster: dependency & lockfile integrity, SBOMs (SPDX/CycloneDX, syft), vulnerability scanning (trivy/grype, CVE triage), image signing & verification (cosign/sigstore keyless, Rekor), provenance & SLSA levels, and admission enforcement that only lets signed, scanned images run — each a hands-on exercise verifying the artifact or policy you produce.
